allowedComments: // A direct git spawn races the Git-for-Windows shim; tests use the pre-enrolled helper.
// A stderr redirect makes Process.Start set STARTF_USESTDHANDLES, inheriting stdin/stdout.
// Drop order: the input channel must close before ConPTY's potentially blocking destructor.
// Git and native validation yield different Windows extended-path forms; use the CLI cwd's.
// Tokio stdin cannot be canceled; a dedicated reader thread lets the CLI exit on its deadline.
// Windows ChildStdin queues blocking writes; flush first or the reader may miss real EOF.
// json_extract maps false and 0 to one SQL integer; parse the JSON to keep them distinct.
